description: Use this to screen a person or entity name against public OFAC SDN (+non-SDN), UK FCDO, UN SC and EU financial sanctions lists. Fuzzy match with scores, programmes, aliases, DOB/nationality where present. Screening aid only - not a regulated AML/KYC determination. Example: {name:"BANCO NACIONAL DE CUBA"}. Batch: sanctions_batch $1. $0.05 USDC. Related: Full KYB pack (UK+VAT+domain+sanctions): /kyb $2.50; many names: /sanctions-batch $1 (<=50); UK officer appointments: /uk-officer $0.15.
name: sanctions_screen
